source_fact: APFC describes the Fund as benefiting Alaskans and supporting both dividends and services.
author_interpretation: Public benefit does not specify a fixed individual dividend.
limit: No present entitlement amount is coded.

source_fact: Lawmakers set distribution; the 2017 judgment upheld the challenged veto and required appropriation.
author_interpretation: A formula alone did not secure the payment claimed in that dispute.
limit: Judgment is historical; not every later dispute is decided here.

source_fact: Board sets investment policy; staff and managers act within delegation; proxy voting objective is risk-adjusted return.
author_interpretation: Voting is managed under the investment mandate.
locators: Board charter pp. 12–14; investment policy II.E and III.A.3 pp. 6–7
limit: No empirical voting outcomes or absence of all other legal remedies is coded.

source_fact: Governor appoints six trustees; board appoints executive director and sets policy.
author_interpretation: Political appointment and delegated management operate at different levels.
column10: Pending HB315 appointment change excluded; no broad independence score.

source_fact: Board duties include audit and public reporting; regular meetings permit public comment.
author_interpretation: A right to speak is distinct from a right to vote as trustee.
locators: Bylaws Article III section 2 p. 8; board charter pp. 12–14
limit: Public influence in practice not measured.

source_fact: Appeal guide covers denied dividend eligibility and administrative then court review.
author_interpretation: Named eligibility process does not establish a power to increase the general appropriation.
limit: Guide documents a route, not success rates or a universal income guarantee.

source_fact: Act translation states the assets are ultimately owned by the state.
author_interpretation: This text describes state ownership, not personal dividend accounts.
limit: English information text only; no exhaustive inventory of citizen rights.

source_fact: Act translation assigns budget transfers to Storting resolution with specified exceptions.
author_interpretation: Fiscal allocation and portfolio management require different authority.
limit: Exceptional liquidity provisions retained; no unconditional prohibition coded.

source_fact: Mandate assigns investment decisions and ownership rights to Norges Bank independently of the Ministry.
author_interpretation: Public ownership alone does not issue an individual voting instruction.
limit: Independence pertains to specified decisions within mandate.

source_fact: Ministry lays supplementary provisions and may change ethical guidelines.
author_interpretation: Mandate-level public authority differs from Bank operational discretion.
limit: No claim about all amendment procedures or Norwegian legal authenticity.

source_fact: Ministry evaluates management and reports to Storting; ethical bodies exchange information and report.
author_interpretation: Reporting and assessment are oversight functions, not an individual remedy by themselves.
limit: Actual influence or enforcement effectiveness not measured.

source_fact: Council initiates cases itself or on Bank request; Bank assesses Council information; new formal exclusion decisions paused during review.
author_interpretation: The available ethical response must be identified separately from the public ethical aim.
locators: Guidelines sections 5–7; government explanation of temporary change
limit: No claim that submission is prohibited or all divestment is barred; individual binding remedy remains unknown.

source_fact: Official fund page describes a Crown asset pool that helps meet future pension costs.
author_interpretation: Pension prefunding does not create personal portfolio accounts in this description.
limit: Description only; whole current statute not verified.

source_fact: Fund contact page says Work and Income administers pensions; fund does not determine individual eligibility.
author_interpretation: The investment manager is not the body that resolves payment administration.
limit: Current withdrawal formula and its amendment rules not coded.

source_fact: Guardians establish investment policies and choose managers; voting page describes governance and proxy guidelines.
author_interpretation: Operational investment authority lies with Guardians in these descriptions.
locators: Our responsibilities; Ownership and voting policy paragraphs
limit: Captured voting page does not establish beneficiary direction or exact execution of a particular vote.

source_fact: Fund describes board oversight, government appointment, and directions constrained by prudent commercial investment.
author_interpretation: Government purpose-setting and manager discretion are bounded differently.
locators: Who decides what; Ministerial directions; Legislative constraints
limit: Official description; amendments not independently resolved.

source_fact: Fund describes Treasury monitoring, auditors and five-year external review reported to Parliament.
author_interpretation: Institutional review is documented; individual investment reversal is not thereby established.
limit: Review effectiveness and current statutory detail not independently assessed.

source_fact: A 2025 information response tells the requester of a right to seek Ombudsman investigation and review.
author_interpretation: The notice establishes a review route for that information decision.
limit: Does not establish a binding investment remedy or its absence elsewhere.
